title: unified rollouts: enhanced quarantine stage + metric-quorum autorollback
author: Ayesha Patel
release_notes: Enhances the Unified Rollouts autorollback flow by adding a quarantine/probing stage and a metric-quorum policy for determining rollback decisions. Improves observability and adds e2e tests to validate stability guards.
description:
Motivation: We continue to see noisy signals and transient regressions cause premature rollbacks in production canary/shadow workflows. This PR introduces a quarantine stage (probing-only traffic) that can be manually or automatically triggered and implements a metric-quorum evaluation for autorollback decisions so that a single noisy metric does not trigger a rollback.

Summary of changes: Adds a quarantine controller and probing stage to the Unified Rollouts workflow; implements metric_quorum policy (configurable threshold + quorum window) used by the autorollback engine; wires observability (new rollout telemetry metrics and dashboards); adds e2e stability tests and CI gating. Includes migration path for existing rollout specs (backwards compatible).

What I changed (high level):
- rollout/autorollback: introduce MetricQuorumPolicy with configurable window, quorum_count, and decay weighting.
- rollout/quarantine: new QuarantineController that sends probing traffic and tracks probe success ratio, with optional manual override and TTL.
- autorollback engine: integrate metric quorum evaluation before triggering rollback; fall back to existing multi-metric logic if quorum not configured.
- observability: add rollout.metric_quorum_evaluation{result,score}, rollout.quarantine_probe_success, and dashboards for visibility.
- e2e: add deterministic preflight tests that simulate transient metric noise and verify no false-positive rollbacks.
- docs: update unified-rollouts docs with configuration examples and migration notes.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-8321)
- [x] Unit + integration tests added
- [x] e2e stability tests added
- [x] Documentation updated
- [x] Backwards compatible config parsing

Testing notes: Local unit/integration ran. CI pipeline initially showed a flaky integration test (probing timing) which I hardened and re-ran; all checks green at merge. Load-tested the quarantine probing controller under simulated production traffic; observed expected reduction in false-positive rollbacks and modest CPU overhead at 5% traffic probing.

Migration: Existing rollout specs without a metric_quorum configuration continue to operate with prior autorollback behavior. To opt-in create a MetricQuorumPolicy block in rollout spec; examples added to docs.

Related: ENG-8364 (observability for autorollback), SUP-1012 (support case describing noisy latency regression causing unintended rollback).

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Important improvement - can we make quorum_count a percentage as well as an absolute? If traffic volume is very low absolute counts are noisy.
Ayesha Patel: Added percentage-based quorum (quorum_percent) and kept quorum_count for backwards compatibility. Updated docs with guidance.
Priya Sharma: Observability looks good; suggest exposing rolling window size in dashboard labels so SRE can correlate to alert windows.
Ayesha Patel: Added dashboard label and emitted metadata on metric_quorum_evaluation with window_seconds.

Gavin Lee: e2e seemed flaky on first run due to timing assumptions in probe scheduler. Recommend retry/backoff.
Ayesha Patel: Hardened scheduler timings and added deterministic clock in tests; re-ran CI and tests passed.
merge_summary: Squash-merged feature/rollouts/quarantine-metric-quorum-autorollback into main; preserves rollback semantics when not configured and adds metric-quorum and quarantine probing as opt-in features.
notes_for_ops: When enabling metric_quorum in production, start with conservative quorum_percent=0.7 and a larger window_seconds (e.g., 300s). The quarantine controller should be used with TTL to avoid long-running probing in case of misconfiguration.
tests_run: unit + integration + e2e stability tests (see e2e/rollouts/quarantine_test.go); load test script used for performance verification.
